name: substack-edit-welcome-email
description: Replace one of a Substack publication's welcome emails (subject and rich-text body). Subject and body are read back in the editor before Save; after Save the publication's own JSON must hold both.
requires: Extension build with the paste_html action (Yeshie branch feat/substack-recipes). scripts/substack.mjs fills editor_title, body_field and subject_field from --kind free|paid.
authorship: Mike Wolf (direction); Claude Opus 5 (CCc), 2026-09-15, from that day's survey of aiwtf.substack.com settings.
anomalies: Settings > Emails lists four welcome emails. Each Edit opens /publish/settings/edit with bodyField and titleField naming publication fields.
Free subscribers: bodyField=unfinished_subscription_email_content, titleField=unfinished_subscription_email_subject (Substack's default subject: "You're on the list!").
Paid subscribers: bodyField=welcome_email_content, titleField=welcome_email_subject (default subject: "Welcome to <publication name>"). Founding members get the paid email unless their own is set.
The subject is a <textarea class='page-title'> (placeholder 'Email subject...'); the body is TipTap ([data-testid='editor']).
Substack's JSON escapes non-ASCII as \uXXXX, so subject_json and proof_text must be the ASCII-escaped forms (scripts/substack.mjs computes subject_json).
